name: FOFA (search API and result pages)
operator: FOFA (Chinese operator; legal entity per the fofa.info terms, to be recorded by the reviewer)
tier_rationale: Chinese operator whose legal entity is not yet recorded (A8 unknown); P049 'Registry tier unknown (Chinese operator; its query logs reveal our targets)', stricter than P057's community: excluded at AMBER, AMBER+STRICT and RED, CLEAR/GREEN only with --allow-unknown, IOC_TYPES selectors only (A8 BR4). A later promotion needs legal_dpo's written decision and keeps the AMBER+ exclusion.

reliability.justification: Internet-wide scan index: banners and fingerprints of varying age, never a verdict by themselves.

fofa_key.description: FOFA API key (sent as the key= URL parameter; masked by the central redactor, AR01)
fofa_key.plan_hint: a paid FOFA membership bought by the company after legal/procurement review incl. LGPD art. 33, recorded in licence_allow (P049)

search_api.title: FOFA search API /api/v1/search/all (paid membership)

terms.quote: Paid licence bought by the company after a legal/procurement review of FOFA's terms and of sending queries to a Chinese provider (LGPD art. 33), recorded in licence_allow.

search_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P049 cond 1). fofa.info/api/v1/search/all?key=&qbase64=&fields=host,ip,port,title (research C0100, unverified: no paid key). IOC_TYPES selectors only (IP, domain, certificate, favicon hash), never e-mails, names or other personal data (P049). The reviewer records FOFA's terms URL and legal entity during the P049 review. Merge only with a trimmed real success fixture captured with the paid key.
search_api.licensed_alternative: The P049 paid licence recorded in licence_allow; until then only the FOFA manual pivot links (fofa.result_pages).

result_pages.title: FOFA result pages en.fofa.info/result?qbase64= (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: FOFA and Criminal IP carry a 'foreign provider: queries are logged abroad - never paste internal host names' badge (legal_dpo, osint_investigator) and max_tlp=green: at TLP:AMBER and above they are hidden from reports and listed only by `v3lum links` with the warning (redteam_lead).

result_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P057 cond 10). Class 'open' is the P057/P062 chair-file class for manual links. en.fofa.info/result?qbase64={b64q}: the vetted base64 placeholder over a fixed query expression (ip=, icon_hash=, cert=), or FOFA is dropped (P057); 'unknown operator' badge, IOC_TYPES values only (A8 BR4). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G14-1, p3-G02-1, p9-G03-1: batches only extend it (fofa__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). reuses_queries true (fail closed): query logs held by a foreign operator under terms not yet reviewed reveal our targets, and the flag keeps P049's AMBER+ exclusion (max_tlp GREEN) even after a tier promotion. Key: P049 names fofa_email and fofa_key; one key per provider and the current API authenticates with the key only (research C0100), so only fofa_key is declared (an e-mail, if still needed, is a non-secret module setting). The key travels in the URL: AR01 redaction before merge. No quota block: the paid membership's figures are not recorded yet.
